recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow correction to the already-applied FHIR-17821 text and aligns the profiling guidance with the authoritative ElementDefinition element path without changing the approved slicing semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-17821 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core profiling clarification for profiling.html#reslicing. It requested replacing the old slicing-rule lead-in, using explicit ElementDefinition element paths with code formatting, and splitting the confusing open/ordered rule text into separate bullets.

Commit e1d09b6749d9af4eb00a66d8d5368a79401257cf later removed only the accidental doubled colon in the lead-in.
additional_context: The current ElementDefinition source defines the element as ElementDefinition.slicing.rules, while ElementDefinition.slicing.ordered remains valid. source/profiling.html is the current core profiling narrative page targeted by the Jira related URL and linked by active core narrative and conformance pages. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches did not reveal a later or conflicting decision for this specific re-slicing wording.
reconciliation: Changed source/profiling.html to use ElementDefinition.slicing in the lead-in and ElementDefinition.slicing.rules in the open-to-closed bullet.
